notes.title: v0.11.0
notes.content:
[p]🎮 [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
Combat Enhancements: Improved health display and damage feedback for smoother battles
User Interface: Enhanced loading screens and improved button responsiveness
Improved Visuals: High-resolution graphics and enhanced visual effects

🛠️ [b]Quality of Life[/b]
Fullscreen Mode: You can now play in fullscreen for a more immersive experience
Performance: Faster loading and improved game stability[/p]

notes.title: v0.9.0
notes.content:
This update brings: 

🎙️ [b]Character Voices! [/b]
All characters now have a handful of voiced callouts they’ll use whenever the situation calls for it. 

🎨 [b]Animations![/b]
 Bridges are breaking and swords are shattering. Watch the action unfold! 

📖 [b]Finalized Demo Routes [/b]
The demo is being finalized and polished. We're excited to get Danger World into your hands!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
We are currently working on full controller and Steam Deck support for Danger World!

In the meantime, the game is playable on Steam Deck with touchscreen input required for combat sections of the game.

Currently, Steam Deck runs the Windows version of the game via Proton. However, we are gauging player interest in a native Linux build.

notes.title: v0.8.0
notes.content:
[b]Danger World v0.8.0 is here![/b]
And with it comes:

📖 More story choices!
Now you can decide how to approach various encounters, or whether to avoid them entirely! Will you save the merchant, or leave him to fend for himself? The choice is yours.

🎨 New character artwork and animations!
Enjoy full animations for Belle’s father, various other townsfolk, and everyone’s favorite cranky old man, Cralius.

🛠️ General fixes
Improvements to UI and visuals
